svg.title: News: Apple’s ‘sexist’ credit card investigated by US regulator
svg.desc: A clipping of the BBC News article of 10 November 2019, “Apple’s ‘sexist’ credit card investigated by US regulator”, cut from the archived page and laid over a blurred view of the full page, with three points summarising the report.
svg.text: A customer said Apple Card gave
him 20 times his wife’s credit limit,
though her credit score was better.
